description.value:
Prerequisites: Dragoon 2 (1st rank), Dragoon 6 (2nd rank), Dragoon 10 (3rd rank)

Gain a +4 bonus to your AC when defending against an attack roll made to confirm a critical hit. This talent may be taken up to three times; the 1st rank being accessible at 2nd level or higher, the 2nd rank at 6th level or higher, and the 3rd rank at 10th level or higher. These effects stack with each other.
